interfaces.name: roller_slot
interfaces.what: two barbed CANTILEVER FINGERS running along x 45.0000..55.0000 (10.0000 mm) at y ~0.5 and ~36.5, topped at z -12.3419 (the foot's own bbox maximum). Their inner gap by height, ray-cast at |x| 50: 36.0890 mm at z -12.3500, 35.4590 at -12.8000, 34.8990 at -13.2000, then a BARB LAND of 34.7000 mm held from z -13.4000 to -14.0000 (0.6000 mm tall), then a POCKET of 36.7000 mm from z -14.5000 down. Lead-in 0.6945 mm per side over 1.0500 mm of rise (33.47 deg half angle); barbs 1.0000 mm proud per side. They capture the ANKLE's 36.5000 mm plate (y 0.1632..36.6632, at z -15.5000..-15.0000) at 0.1000 mm per side, needing 0.9000 mm of deflection per finger to pass and standing 0.9000 mm over its shoulder. CORRECTED 2026-09-02 (lane T): this row previously said 'the clip-on roller drops between them', and no roller shares any MJCF with this foot — roller_blade/tire/rim occur only in robot_allcollisions_rollers.xml, which carries no foot or sole geom and swaps the ankle for ankle_l_v1/ankle_r_v1 (vertical Ø2.2/Ø3.5 at (50.1090, -5.5000), matching roller_blade's own Ø1.6 pilot there, where this ankle's is at (50.0000, 4.5020)). The R16.5 relief band at y 12.9000..31.1000 across the rib tops, measured previously in this folder, stands. See connection:snap-fit-roller-axle.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's foot and ankle meshes by cecad.meshfeatures.intervals ray-cast calipers (finger inner faces along y at |x| 50 for z -12.3500 .. -15.0000; finger x span along x at y 0.0 and 37.0; ankle plate width along y at |x| 50 for z -13.6000 .. -15.5000) plus the mesh inventory of all four of Pollen's MJCF files; frozen in ce-connections/snap-fit-roller-axle/iterations/v0.0.1/evidence/roller-slot-fit.json, 2026-09-02 (lane T)
interfaces.name_is_legacy_why: the name 'roller_slot' is kept so that nothing referencing it dangles; the CLAIM is corrected. connection:snap-fit-roller-axle compat.py carries `captures_what` as the regression guard.
